say:1:1732336001:1.text: *Chitter*! Smart of you to catch that!
say:1:1732336001:1.source_cn: 嗷吼！聪明的人类，你看出来了！
say:1:1732336001:1.male: *Chitter*! Smart of you to catch that!
say:1:1732336001:1.female: *Chitter*! Smart of you to catch that!

say:2:1732336002:1.text: *Chitter*! Now, hold your tongue and pray to Dura!
say:2:1732336002:1.source_cn: 嗷吼！现在不要说话，和我一起向艾雅祷告！
say:2:1732336002:1.male: *Chitter*! Now, hold your tongue and pray to Dura!
say:2:1732336002:1.female: *Chitter*! Now, hold your tongue and pray to Dura!

say:3:1732336003:1.text: *Chitter*! Dura's blessing will banish those Hypofiends from the Hall of Ancients!
say:3:1732336003:1.source_cn: 嗷吼！女神必定降下的庇护，将驱除圣古堂的魔物。
say:3:1732336003:1.male: *Chitter*! Dura's blessing will banish those Hypofiends from the Hall of Ancients!
say:3:1732336003:1.female: *Chitter*! Dura's blessing will banish those Hypofiends from the Hall of Ancients!
